title: My React form loses a field when I go back a step
body: I split a registration form into three components. Going back to step one clears the inputs. Should the parent own all of this state?

title: Does this filter need useEffect at all?
body: I have a list and a search input. I'm using an effect to put matching items into another state variable. It works, but feels like extra work.

title: How do you test keyboard navigation without a mouse?
body: Trying to check our club website before the demo. I can tab through it, but I'm not sure what counts as broken.

title: Our Django query count climbs with every card
body: The project list works, but the debug toolbar shows another query for each author's name. Is select_related the right fix?

title: Should an empty search return everything?
body: In our resource browser an empty search currently returns zero results. A teammate thinks it should show recent items instead. What would you expect?

title: PostgreSQL dates are making my deadline move a day
body: A deadline entered as 2026-10-02 shows as October 1 for one teammate. It's a date, not a meeting time. What should we store?

title: What goes in the README when the project is unfinished?
body: Two screens work and two don't. I want to share the repo for feedback without making it sound finished.

title: Need a second pair of eyes on our database roles
body: We have owners, members and visitors. Should the API be the only place checking who can edit a project?

title: How small can a useful first open-source contribution be?
body: I found a typo in setup instructions but it feels too small to send a pull request for.

title: Anyone else stuck choosing between two project ideas?
body: One idea is more interesting, the other is something I could actually finish this term. Three people on the team and exams in six weeks.

title: Our survey has 23 responses. Is that enough to show a chart?
body: It's for a class presentation, not a published study. I don't want a neat chart to make the result look more certain than it is.

title: Flutter list jumps after I load older items
body: Building a small notes app. When older notes load at the top, the screen jumps and I lose my place.

title: What does a good bug report look like for a class team?
body: Our group chat is full of 'it doesn't work'. I want a small template that people will actually use.

title: Can we skip a login screen for the first prototype?
body: The core idea is a calculator. We're spending more time on accounts than the calculation itself.

title: Git says both of us changed the same file
body: First group project. I have a merge conflict in our routes file and I'm scared I'll erase my teammate's work.

title: Is it okay to use a simple baseline for an ML project?
body: Our classifier barely beats a majority-class baseline. The deadline is next week. I'm not sure what to write in the report.

title: Figma prototype looks fine until someone uses a longer name
body: Our cards were designed with very short labels. Now they look cramped with real content. Any quick way to stress test this?

title: How do you ask for help without pasting the whole project?
body: I keep writing massive questions and deleting them. What details do people actually need?

title: Our stock count can go negative. Prevent it or record it?
body: Helping a small shop with a class prototype. A sale entered late can make the count negative even when it was a real sale.

title: Can a chart use colour if it also has labels?
body: We have three lines and direct labels at the end. Do we still need different dash styles?

title: Looking for a study buddy for SQL joins
body: I'm comfortable with SELECT and WHERE but joins still take me ages. Anyone interested in doing a few tiny examples together this weekend?

title: How do you handle a teammate disappearing near the deadline?
body: They were active at the start but haven't replied this week. I don't want to assume they're being lazy.

title: Do portfolio screenshots need fake activity numbers?
body: The empty version of my dashboard looks less impressive, but random big numbers feel wrong. What do you usually show?

title: Deploying a student project without leaving secrets in Git
body: I noticed an API key in our first commit. I removed the file in a new commit. Is that enough?

title: Our model is good on train and bad on validation
body: It's a small image dataset for a class assignment. Accuracy looks great on train but drops a lot on a separate folder.

title: Do you write tests before the first prototype?
body: We have a tiny expense-splitting prototype. Trying to decide what deserves tests this early.

title: What's a useful question to ask after a usability test?
body: I keep asking 'was it easy?' and everyone says yes even after getting stuck.

title: Trying to make a CSV import less fragile
body: Our import fails when a description contains a comma or a line break. Is there a better separator?

title: How much detail should a task description have?
body: Our board has tasks like 'backend' and nobody knows when they're done. I want to improve it without writing an essay per card.

title: Can I use a university logo in a fictional demo?
body: The project is a student prototype and isn't affiliated with the university. I don't want the mockup to look official.

title: How do you keep dates readable across countries?
body: Our cards say 04/05 and half the team reads it differently. Should we force one format?

title: Anyone tried QGIS for a non-geography class project?
body: I have a CSV of public park locations and want to make a simple map. Most tutorials assume I already know GIS terms.

title: Should deleted comments disappear or leave a marker?
body: A deleted parent comment makes replies confusing in our prototype. We haven't decided what should happen.

title: I finally reproduced the double-booking bug
body: Two people could reserve the same equipment slot if they clicked together. Normal manual testing never caught it.

title: How do you pick a first issue in a repo you don't know?
body: There are lots of good-first-issue labels, but some haven't had a reply in months.

title: Our accessibility checklist is getting too long
body: We can't finish every improvement before the class demo. How would you choose what to do first?

title: Do I need Docker for a two-person Django project?
body: One of us is on Windows, one on Linux. Most of the trouble is setting up the database the same way.

title: What should we do with missing survey answers?
body: Some people skipped the last three questions. Replacing blanks with zero seems wrong but breaks my spreadsheet chart.

title: How do you make a short project demo less stressful?
body: Five minutes, one laptop, unreliable Wi-Fi. I'm more nervous about the setup than the speaking.

title: When is localStorage the wrong place for a draft?
body: We want form drafts to survive reloads. The form might contain personal notes, though.

title: Learning Linux permissions one error at a time
body: I keep using sudo when something fails and now half my project files have a different owner. How do I untangle this?

title: How can a business student help on a technical team?
body: I can do research and spreadsheets but I'm new to coding. I don't want to just make presentation slides.

title: What does 'done' mean for a student research prototype?
body: Our supervisor wants a working demonstration. We keep adding features because the tool doesn't feel finished.

title: Blender exports are too large for our gallery page
body: The scene looks fine on my laptop but takes forever to load on a phone. Where would you start?

title: How do you ask a mentor for feedback on code?
body: I have a repo but I'm not sure what to ask beyond 'is this good?'.

title: Simple project ideas for learning database transactions?
body: I understand commit and rollback on paper. Looking for a tiny example where they really matter.

title: What would make you trust a project progress bar?
body: Ours counts completed tasks, but one huge task and five tiny tasks make the number misleading.

title: Phone camera photos rotate after uploading
body: The preview looks right on my phone, then sideways on the project page. Anyone seen this?

title: How do you keep a project alive during exams?
body: We're enjoying it but none of us can promise weekly releases this month.

title: Can an API return a useful error without leaking details?
body: Right now users see the database exception text. It helped us debug but doesn't seem right for normal use.

title: Our club wants a newsletter. Is a spreadsheet enough first?
body: I'm the person building the site and everyone immediately asked for an admin dashboard. We have about thirty interested readers.

title: How do you give helpful feedback on a rough design?
body: My teammate asked for feedback but all I can think is 'it looks busy'. I want to be more specific.

title: SQL count is bigger after adding a join
body: The project count doubles when I join members and tasks. Both tables have several rows per project. What am I missing?

title: Anyone learning technical writing alongside programming?
body: I can make the code work but explaining the setup is taking longer than I expected.

title: What should an offline app do when two edits disagree?
body: Our field notes app can be edited on two devices. Last-write-wins is easy, but I don't want to silently lose notes.

title: How do you explain a project that didn't meet its goal?
body: Our prototype worked technically but nobody wanted to use it twice. Can that still go in a portfolio?

title: Need ideas for testing a map without asking people to travel
body: Our student map prototype has only a few locations. We want feedback on the interface before collecting more data.

title: Python virtual environments finally make sense
body: Small win: rebuilt my project on another laptop using the requirements file. Last month I copied the whole environment folder.

title: Should notifications link to a comment or the whole discussion?
body: We show 'new reply' but the link lands at the top of a long discussion. Is that good enough for a first release?

title: How do you decide which skills to put on a profile?
body: I've used several tools once in class. Listing all of them as advanced feels wrong.

title: Is a paused project the same thing as a failed project?
body: We paused ours because two teammates started placements. It still has useful work in it.

title: How do you hand over a student project before placements?
body: Two of us start placements next month. The prototype works on our laptops but the next team will need to maintain it. What should we leave them?

title: What goes into a brief for a two-week student prototype?
body: Our team keeps adding features before agreeing on the problem. What belongs in a brief we will actually read?
